subject: Medcord security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@medcord.com>; Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medcord.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Medcord security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can accelerate procurement and security review: 

- Redwood action items:
  1) Share SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter (if SOC 2 Type II is in progress)
  2) Provision temporary read-only access to our trust portal for Medcord security team
  3) Accept/upload your vendor security questionnaire (if you want to send it)
  4) Provide a short note on GDPR/HIPAA applicability and our DPA/DPR options

Could you confirm which of the above you want us to start with? If you can send your vendor security questionnaire, we’ll start mapping required artifacts (reports, policies, attestation).

I’m copying Jordan from Security and Ben from Sales Ops to coordinate the portal invite and bridge-letter template. We can usually provide a temporary portal share within 24–48 hours and a templated bridge letter the same day we confirm the scope.

Proposed timeline: intake + questionnaire mapping by EOB tomorrow, portal access by Thursday. Does that work on your side?

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: none
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@medcord.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medcord.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medcord security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Thanks Tessa — great session. Quick answers from our side: 

- We are evaluating Redwood for a pilot and procurement will want to see a SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months. If a full Type II is not available, a bridge letter describing the testing window + compensating controls is acceptable for initial review.
- We have a vendor security questionnaire attached (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_MEDCORD.xlsx) — please confirm you received it and if you prefer upload to a portal or email back completed sections.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Medcord is HIPAA covered and has EU customers — we need confirmation of data residency options, a DPA template, and whether Redwood supports BAA for PHI-handling workloads.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provide access to the trust portal (read-only) so our security team can pull artifacts directly?
2) Can you share a standard bridge letter template and a short summary of how Redwood handles PHI?

We’d like to keep the momentum and can get procurement involved next week if we have those materials.

Best,
Alex Reed
Head of IT Security, Medcord

Attachments (sent): Medcord_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@medcord.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Medcord security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the questionnaire — got it. Next steps from Redwood security/ops: 

1) Portal access: we’ll provision a temporary read-only link for Medcord to the Redwood Trust Portal (scope: SOC 2 artifacts, policies, recent penetration test summary). You should receive an invite by EOD today. Portal link is https://trust.redwood.example.com/portal/medcord-4721 (temp creds -> expires in 7 days).

2) Bridge letter & artifacts: attaching our standard Bridge Letter template (Redwood_BridgeLetter_Template_v1.docx) and a short DPA summary (Redwood_DPA_Summary.pdf) that outlines data processing options and BAA support. For HIPAA/PHI: Redwood offers a standalone BAA for Private deployments and can discuss scope for hosted and dedicated contracts — we’ll coordinate legal as needed.

3) Questionnaire: we’ll upload a marked-up copy to the portal with references to the artifacts you requested. If there are any flagged items, Jordan will follow up directly.

Proposed timeline: portal invite today, bridge letter draft same day, final SOC 2 Type II report (if available) via portal — otherwise we’ll provide an interim attestation and expected delivery window. 

If you want us to pre-populate sections of your questionnaire, reply and we’ll attach the marked-up version.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Security & Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_BridgeLetter_Template_v1.docx; Redwood_DPA_Summary.pdf

Ben / Tessa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments — I see the portal invite come through and was able to log in. I uploaded our Vendor_Security_Questionnaire to the Projects folder. Couple quick clarifications: 

- The bridge letter template looks good; can you confirm the testing window you’ll reference (most procurement folks want an explicit date range)?
- For the BAA: we’ll need a draft or point of contact at Redwood legal to start that conversation.
- On data residency: we’d like a note in the portal about whether logs/metrics for our tenant can be restricted to US regions — you mentioned Dedicated/Private options during the demo, but procurement wants the explicit mechanism.

If you want, I can loop in procurement next week for a brief sync. Otherwise we’ll review the marked-up questionnaire and post comments by Friday.

Thanks —
Alex
Head of IT Security, Medcord
